nights.title: Choir! Choir! Choir! - Un-Silent Night: An EPIC Holiday Sing-Along!
nights.name: Choir! Choir! Choir!
nights.extract: Choir! Choir! Choir! is a Canadian musical choir, based in Toronto, Ontario. Instead of a traditional organizational model, the choir is structured as an open participation group where anybody who wants to attend an event is welcome to perform as part of the choir.
